entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Watch
entry.summary:
From around 1:00 pm until early evening there is a moderate risk that thunderstorms may become severe about inland parts of the South Island north of Tekapo, as drawn on the chart. Severe thunderstorms will produce localised downpours with rainfall rates of 25 to 40 mm per hour.
Rainfall of this intensity can cause surface and/or flash flooding, especially about low-lying areas such as streams, rivers or narrow valleys, and may also lead to slips.
Driving conditions will also be hazardous with surface flooding and poor visibility in heavy rain.

entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
entry.summary:
At 04:37 pm, MetService weather radar detected severe thunderstorms near TE KUITI, OTOROHANGA, WAITOMO CAVES, PIRONGIA MOUNTAIN, NGUTUNUI and HONIKIWI.
These severe thunderstorms are moving towards the southsoutheast, and are expected to lie near TE KUITI, OTOROHANGA, WAITOMO CAVES and MOKAUITI at 05:07 pm and near BENNEYDALE, ONGARUE, WAIMIHA, MOKAUITI, WAIPA VALLEY, MANGAPEHI and PAEWHENUA at 05:37 pm.
These thunderstorms are expected to be accompanied by torrential rain and hail.
Impact:
Torrential rain can cause surface and/or flash flooding about streams, gullies and urban areas, and make driving conditions extremely hazardous.
Hail can cause damage to crops, orchards and vines and may make driving conditions hazardous.

entry.title: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
entry.summary:
At 04:52 pm, MetService weather radar detected severe thunderstorms near AUCKLAND, HOWICK, AUCKLAND CITY, SOUTH AUCKLAND, WARKWORTH, OREWA, PUHOI and AHUROA.
These severe thunderstorms are moving towards the southeast, and are expected to lie near PAPAKURA, HUNUA, AUCKLAND, OREWA, ALBANY, INNER HAURAKI GULF, DAIRY FLAT, WHANGAPARAOA and SILVERDALE at 05:22 pm and near HUNUA, MARAMARUA, MANGATAWHIRI, THE HUNUA RANGES, AUCKLAND, INNER HAURAKI GULF and WHANGAPARAOA at 05:52 pm.
These thunderstorms are expected to be accompanied by torrential rain and large hail.
Impact:
Torrential rain can cause surface and/or flash flooding about streams, gullies and urban areas, and make driving conditions extremely hazardous.
Large hail can cause significant damage to crops, orchards, vines, glasshouses and vehicles, and make driving conditions hazardous.
